# Fuzz targets that CI runs, one per line: <package> <target>.
#
# 30 seconds each on every pull request, one hour each nightly. A target
# is listed once the code it exercises survives fuzzing; a finding is
# fixed and its input is committed under the package's testdata/fuzz.
./internal/syntax FuzzParser
./internal/content FuzzScanner
./internal/content FuzzSameAsBefore
./internal/font FuzzCMap
./internal/font FuzzFont
./internal/charset FuzzTextString
./internal/file FuzzOpen
./internal/file FuzzRebuild
./internal/file FuzzFilters
./internal/file FuzzDecrypt
./internal/file FuzzEncryptedOpen
./internal/extract FuzzExtract
. FuzzOpen
. FuzzPage
. FuzzPacket
./internal/file FuzzEnvelope
. FuzzXFAData
./internal/function FuzzCalculator
. FuzzImageData
. FuzzSamplePNG
./internal/ccitt FuzzDecode
./internal/font FuzzOutlineHashes
./internal/font FuzzCFFEncoding
./internal/font FuzzTrueTypeProgram
./internal/font FuzzCMapChars
./internal/font FuzzFace
./internal/xps FuzzIndices
. FuzzXPSPage
